xmldoc.short_description: Convert indexed image to RGB using a colormap.

param_input_item.param_description: Indexed image. Integer and logical arrays use zero-based indices; double and single arrays use one-based indices.
Colormap with at least three columns.

param_output_item.param_description: Double RGB image built from the first three columns of map.

description.p: Convert indexed image to RGB using the first three columns of a colormap. Integer and logical indexed images use zero-based indices. Double and single indexed images use one-based indices. Integer-valued indices outside the colormap range are clamped to the nearest valid row. Empty indexed images return an empty RGB array.

example_item.example_item_description: Clamp indices outside the colormap range
